findings.summary: Local/test profile registers two XoxodayApiClient beans
findings.details: XoxodayApiClientImpl is always registered as a @Service while XoxodayApiClientStub is also registered for local/localtest/test. XoxodaySyncJobService constructor injects XoxodayApiClient with no @Primary or @Qualifier, so under localtest Spring has two candidates and fails context startup.
findings.recommendation: Add @Profile("!local & !localtest & !test") to XoxodayApiClientImpl so it is excluded under those profiles, leaving the stub as the sole candidate.

findings.summary: Catalog updates can leave active items in invalid redemption states
findings.details: createCatalogItem rejects CASH+returnable and activateCatalogItem rejects active NON_CASH without providerItemId, but updateCatalogItem bypasses both invariants.
findings.recommendation: After applying updates, validate invariants before saving: active NON_CASH requires providerItemId, CASH cannot be returnable.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
